start: The admin app opened on a laptop, signed in as owner

steps.action: Open the app
user_sees: Today; on the left the menu under five headings (Members, Money, Training, Reach members, Your gym); at the top the gym's logo next to the gym's name
must_not: Another gym's logo or name; a page name cut off in the menu

steps.action: Click a menu page, for example Plans, then Expenses
user_sees: Each page opens; the address changes; the menu marks where you are
must_not: A blank page; the menu marking the wrong page

steps.action: At the top right, open "Screen and language" and pick "Light", then "Dark"
user_sees: The whole app changes colour at once
must_not: One part of the page left in the old colours; unreadable text

steps.action: Pick "Hinglish", then "English"
user_sees: The words change at once
must_not: A raw text key; half the page in each language

start: The admin app on a phone: bottom bar and "More" (address /more)

steps.action: Open the app on a phone
user_sees: A bottom bar with the main pages and "More"; the round button "Screen and language" at the top right
must_not: The laptop side menu squeezed onto the phone

steps.action: Tap "More"
user_sees: Rows in the menu's order, each with a hint: "Set up your gym" on top while steps are left (with its ring), "Enquiries", "Invite members", "Plans", "Shop", "Expenses", "Your growth", "Trainers", "Workout plans", "Diet plans", "Challenges", "Messages & offers" and the rest
must_not: A page that the side menu has but More does not; a count badge that differs from the page behind it

steps.action: Tap a row, then the phone's back button
user_sees: The page, then More again
must_not: The app closing on back

start: The old web address (forgeai.aakashpahuja.in) opened from an old bookmark or home-screen icon

steps.action: Open the old address with nothing waiting to send
user_sees: The app opens app.mettleup.fit by itself; there, once: "MettleUp is now at app.mettleup.fit. Save this address. If you had the admin app on your home screen, add it again from here to replace the old one."
must_not: A sign-in asked again with no reason given; records left behind on the old address

steps.action: Open the old address while payments taken offline still wait to send
user_sees: A line at the top saying why the page is still here; after they are sent: "Everything is sent. This page opens app.mettleup.fit after you stop typing for a minute, or tap “Open it now”."
must_not: The move happening in the middle of a half-filled form; waiting payments lost by the move

start: No internet, and a wrong address

steps.action: Turn the internet off and open Messages & offers
user_sees: "Messages & offers needs the internet" with "This page opens when the internet is back. Open Members to save check-ins, payments and new members now."
must_not: A spinner that never ends; a half-working page that loses what is typed

steps.action: Open Members while still offline
user_sees: Members opens and works
must_not: Members blocked too

steps.action: Type an address that is no page, for example /nothing
user_sees: A page that opens (Today) or a plain "not found" (which one was not read)
must_not: A blank white page

start: The Dark | Light and English | Hinglish choices over time

steps.action: Pick Light and Hinglish, then reload the page
user_sees: Still Light and Hinglish
must_not: The app back in Dark or English after a reload; a flash of the other theme first

steps.action: Sign out and look at the sign-in page
user_sees: The same language choice is offered there too
must_not: The sign-in page in a language the user did not pick

steps.action: Switch back to Dark and English
user_sees: Everything as it was at the start
must_not: A word left in Hinglish

start: What leaves the device from the frame: crash reports, and who sees the logo

steps.action: A page breaks with an error nobody caught
user_sees: The user sees whatever the page shows; in the background one short report goes to MettleUp: the error words, a short stack, the page's path with ids taken out, the app version
must_not: A gym name, a member name or number, or a member id in the report; more than 5 reports from one page load

steps.action: Read the privacy notice on crash reports
user_sees: Crash reports go to a private bug list
must_not: An error message that carries a member's name sent as it is

steps.action: Sign in as front desk
user_sees: The same gym logo in the header
must_not: A logo of another gym

start: The admin app, signed in as front desk

steps.action: Open the app
user_sees: Today; the menu without Expenses, Your growth, Set up your gym, AI Assistant and All branches; the gym's logo and name on top
must_not: An owner-only page listed, greyed or not; an empty gap where it would be

steps.action: Open the menu row "Workout offer"
user_sees: The desk's workout offer list, hint "Give members the rewards they earned"
must_not: The owner's message writer

steps.action: Switch Dark | Light and English | Hinglish at the top
user_sees: The same switches as the owner has
must_not: A setting that changes the owner's device too

steps.action: Tap "More"
user_sees: The rows the desk may open, with desk wording (Challenges: "Who has reached the goal"); "Workout offer" is its own row
must_not: "Expenses" or "Your growth" in the list

start: An owner-only page by typed address or old link

steps.action: Type /expenses, then /growth, /setup, /assistant, /settings/branding, /numbers/owed
user_sees: "Only an owner can see this" with "Ask your gym owner if you need something from here." and the button "Back to Today" each time
must_not: The page, or its numbers, shown even for a moment

steps.action: Tap "Back to Today"
user_sees: Today
must_not: A loop back to the blocked page

steps.action: Turn the internet off and open Workout plans
user_sees: "Workout plans needs the internet" with "This page opens when the internet is back. Open Members to save check-ins, payments and new members now."
must_not: An error page

start: A blocked page, before and after the owner changes the role

steps.action: As front desk, open /expenses
user_sees: The owner-only card
must_not: Any expense row

steps.action: The owner makes this person an owner; they sign in again and open /expenses
user_sees: Expenses opens and is in the menu
must_not: The old block still shown; the menu and the page disagreeing

start: What the desk can see through the frame

steps.action: Look through every menu page as front desk
user_sees: No money totals, profit or expenses anywhere
must_not: A total hidden on one page but shown on another

steps.action: Note for the audit: the whole gym's list is still loaded onto the desk device (the code says so itself)
user_sees: Nothing on screen
must_not: Totals readable by the desk in the normal screens

start: The admin app, signed in as a staff person with the Trainer tick

steps.action: Open the app
user_sees: The desk menu plus, under Training: "Training progress" ("Your members’ workout progress") and "Member questions" with a count of open questions
must_not: "Members’ workout progress, and their trainer" (the owner's wording); a count that is not this trainer's

steps.action: Open "Workout plans" and "Diet plans"
user_sees: Both open: trainers write the plans
must_not: An owner-only block on Workout plans

steps.action: Open "Training progress"
user_sees: This trainer's members
must_not: Members assigned to another trainer, unless the server allows it

steps.action: Tap "More"
user_sees: The same Training rows as the side menu, with the same count on "Member questions"
must_not: A badge on More that differs from the side menu's

start: Pages a trainer may not open

steps.action: Type /expenses or /growth
user_sees: "Only an owner can see this" with "Ask your gym owner if you need something from here." and the button "Back to Today"
must_not: Money totals shown to a trainer

steps.action: Turn the internet off and open Member questions or Trainers
user_sees: "Member questions needs the internet" with "This page opens when the internet is back. Open Members to save check-ins, payments and new members now."
must_not: Old questions shown as if they were current

start: The Trainer tick switched off and on

steps.action: The owner takes the Trainer tick off this person; they reload
user_sees: "Training progress" and "Member questions" leave the menu and More
must_not: The rows still there, opening an error

steps.action: Open the old address /trainer or /questions
user_sees: The page says in plain words that it is not for this person
must_not: Members' progress or questions shown to someone without the tick

steps.action: The owner ticks Trainer again; reload
user_sees: The two rows are back
must_not: A sign-out needed with no hint

start: What a trainer sees of members and of the gym

steps.action: Open Member questions
user_sees: Only questions addressed to this trainer
must_not: Questions sent to another trainer; a complaint meant for the owner

steps.action: Look for money pages
user_sees: None beyond what the desk has
must_not: Expenses, profit or collections
